target.role: Comparison only; never read by prediction()
target.assumptions: Planck 2018 TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing base LambdaCDM, baseline Plik; hidden relic interpreted as cold, collisionless gravitating matter
target.source: Planck Collaboration, A&A 641, A6 (2020), arXiv:1807.06209v4, Tables 1/2 and matter-density result
target.not_blind: Published and already known; held out from calibration/parameter fitting only. This is a conditional external-constraint comparison, not a fresh raw CMB likelihood fit or an independent detection.

no_refit: The 100 GeV / YQ=YB point is retained and rejected; derived constraint is not fed back to select a new mass.
missing_for_positive_empirical_success: Derived/calibrated hidden charge production or independently constrained initial yield
Late relic distribution, equation of state and survival under cosmological evolution
Direct forward CMB or another observable likelihood for an independently fixed viable point
